claim: Pollstar reported that Taylor Swift's Eras Tour had so far grossed more than $1 billion, the first tour to do so.
excerpt: Taylor Swift’s Eras Tour has so far grossed more than $1 billion, according to Pollstar.
context: Figure is a floor ('more than'), reported 'so far' in December 2023 and attributed to Pollstar. Headline: 'first tour to gross more than $1 billion'.

claim: Elton John's Farewell Yellow Brick Road Tour set the previous touring record with $939 million.
excerpt: Elton John’s Farewell Yellow Brick Road Tour set the previous touring record with $939 million
context: The report's wording. Billboard's own Boxscore ranks only officially reported figures and is a different basis; this video uses the Music Week/Pollstar framing only.

claim: Elton John's $939 million was amassed over five years, due to pandemic delays.
excerpt: although that huge total was amassed over five years due to pandemic delays.
context: Says nothing about how long the Eras Tour took, and the video says nothing either.

claim: Previous record-breaking tours by U2, Ed Sheeran and Elton John all included many more performances.
excerpt: making it bigger than previous record-breaking tours by U2, Ed Sheeran and Elton John which all included many more performances
context: 'Many more performances' is the report's wording; no show counts were retrieved, so none are shown.
